items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a guy on the scene that you probably maybe have not heard his name. Eddie Costa? ... I remember Joe Morello loved Eddie Costa’s playing.

ctx.x: Horace Silver, Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers, Les McCann, Hampton Hawes, what was that? . . . Bobby Timmons. How did . . . would that music . . . did you find that somewhat exciting during that period too?

Oh yes. But then they had . . . all those people had very lean left hands. They only played an open chord. They didn’t play harmonically rich stuff like Bill Evans, but that was a period I think when everybody including me was trying to play that way. There was a guy on the scene that you probably maybe have not heard his name. Eddie Costa?
